Goodbye, Passwords Hello, Passkeys It’s about damn time - Unique - Public Key Cryptography (WebAuthN) - Private Key remains on device* - Leverages modern tech (ie/ biometrics, ubikeys) - Less Friction - Technically multifactor - Promoted by the major players in the industry - Google, Apple

Quick History on WebAuthN - First proposed in 2013, Finalized in 2019 - Secure authentication on the web without requiring passwords - Joint effort between the FIDO Alliance the W3C - Fast IDentity Online Alliance - Universal 2nd Factor (U2F) - Universal Authentication Framework (UAF) - FIDO2

* About that asterisk… - Unique per device would indicate unique per device - Passkey on your laptop != passkey on your phone != passkey on your tablet - Secret keys are being synced to the cloud now so you don’t have to worry about logging in and setting a new - iCloud, Google Password Manager, 1Password - Still… this isn’t ideal.
